# BHMarketer.ai Trustpilot Review Removal Service FAQ

> 50 questions and answers about the BHMarketer.ai Trustpilot Review Removal Service: what it is, which reviews can be reported, turnaround time (TAT), ordering, pricing, results and support. BHMarketer.ai assists with assessing and reporting reviews; Trustpilot makes the final removal decision and no removal is guaranteed. The repository also scores a Trustpilot review's removal eligibility from 0 to 100 against the five reasons Trustpilot accepts when a business reports a review.
